description: creep.yaml and ~/.creep/config.yaml. Generated from internal/config; do not edit by hand.

max_calls.description: Maximum model calls per scan. The project file may only lower it.

max_tokens.description: Maximum model tokens per scan. The project file may only lower it.

cache_days.description: Days a model calibration stays valid. The project file may only lower it.

allow.description: Hosts (host or host:port) the gateway may contact. Cannot be set in the project file.

pr.description: Pull request gate: <status>:<severity> or none. Exit 1 when a finding reaches it.

contract.description: How creep talks to the model: an HTTP API (openai, anthropic) or a local command. Cannot be set in the project file.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the model API (http:// or https://). Cannot be set in the project file.

env.description: Names of extra environment variables passed to the model command (the rest of the environment is not). Cannot be set in the project file.

max_output_bytes.description: Largest stdout a model command call may print. The project file may only lower it.

name.description: Model name sent to the endpoint. Cannot be set in the project file.

preset.description: Name of a model CLI preset built into creep (claude-code, codex, gemini, ollama): sets model.run and contract command. Cannot be set in the project file.

run.description: Command line of a model CLI for contract command: prompt on stdin, JSON on stdout. Split without a shell. Cannot be set in the project file.

tier.description: Unused: the scan takes the tier from calibration. Reserved for a forced-tier option. Cannot be set in the project file.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds one model command call may run before it is killed. The project file may only lower it.

format.description: Terminal output format (flag --format). Cannot be set in the project file.

formats.description: Report files written after a scan. Cannot be set in the project file.

enabled.description: Run proofs of concept in a container (v0.2). The sandbox never has internet access. Cannot be set in the project file.

runtime.description: Container runtime for the sandbox. Cannot be set in the project file.

enabled.description: Optional external scanners to run offline when installed (gitleaks, osv-scanner; semgrep is only detected). Cannot be set in the project file.

title: creep project and user configuration
